metadata.description: Opinionated skill collection for professional software engineering workflows — modular, replaceable packages for every phase of daily work and SDLC.

plugins.name: strict-workday
plugins.description: Skills for daily work execution — operating rhythm, focus, time management, day planning.

plugins.name: strict-labs
plugins.description: Experimental and unstable content — early skills and drafts being evaluated.

plugins.name: strict-development
plugins.description: Skills for engineering implementation — changelog generation, technical design, PR preparation.

plugins.name: strict-management
plugins.description: Skills for management and lead-level planning — schedules, Gantt charts, sprint prep, prioritization, backlog shaping.

plugins.name: strict-agents-creator
plugins.description: Create scoped Claude Code subagents from a task or role, with a mandatory golden eval contract.

plugins.name: strict-script-creator
plugins.description: Turn a repeated routine into a reusable script, then reuse it and remove what nothing calls.

plugins.name: strict-workflows
plugins.description: Composed end-to-end workflows — reusable multi-step flows that combine lower-level skills from other packages across the full SDLC.
